classification: synthetic mechanics and hybrid rendering experiment; not complete K3 or real-world reconstruction

syntheticInput.origin: original generated Gaussian soil grid and three rock hemispheres
syntheticInput.relightingProxy: optional aligned coarse sphere/soil mesh; no collision

externalInput.alignment: explicit and inspected, not inferred from visual plausibility
externalInput.proxyRequirement: matched mesh required before external proxy relighting

generatedModelMode.coordinates: normalized Unity RUF, identity transform matching surface-sampled PLY
generatedModelMode.sourceMeshRoot: render-only mesh, no collider, independently toggled by runtime
generatedModelMode.ordinaryExterior: existing outer wall and roof renderers hidden, colliders retained
generatedModelMode.sharedGeometry: ground, inner lining, door, doorframe, camera and lamp remain across representation changes
generatedModelMode.doorOpening: source model clipped by converter at x +/- .70, y <2.15, z <.65; builder frame hides cut edges
generatedModelMode.cyanReason: in front of generated source, offset from x2 wall collision test
generatedModelMode.texture: original JPG bytes hashed before and after copy; 4096 import; URP Lit mesh material
generatedModelMode.comparison: same generated source textured mesh versus surface-sampled Gaussian representation, with common-only visibility control

proxyRelighting.mesh: same GeneratedStation mesh asset as baseline, child of splat root
proxyRelighting.capture: main SourceCamera Refresh and RenderNow before same-pose separate-camera request; runtime verifies support and matching view
limits: arbitrary different photo camera views unverified

innerLining.reason: ordinary opaque interior built in front of sampled exterior surface; not renderer occlusion repair
